# Nginx package update for PHP apps on Azure App Service

## What Changed

We’re updating the Nginx packages used in Azure App Service PHP images, moving from the deprecated deb.sury.org repository to the official nginx.org repository. This follows the upstream repository changes.

## Why It Matters to a CSA

This can create a customer delivery blocker or migration requirement.

## Customer Impact

**High**. Lifecycle: `unknown`. Change type: `deprecated`.

## Recommended Action

Identify affected workloads, verify the effective date, and create a tested migration action.
